footnotes: The income statement doesn't separate operating from non-operating items in a form this page can follow, so costs and expenses are shown in total down to pre-tax income. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 2.8% to $1.2B in 2025. Operating income fell 2.2% to $859M, a 69.5% margin.
Net income fell 2.0% to $674M, or $4.52 per share. Operating cash flow was $725M and free cash flow $725M, versus $686M; Enact returned $503M through dividends and buybacks.
sources: Enact Holdings, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
